text: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity; it is stained with blood.

title: Hosea 6:9
text: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way toward Shechem; yea, they have committed lewdness.

title: Hosea 6:10
text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: there whoredom is [found] in Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

title: Hosea 6:11
text: Also, O Judah, there is a harvest appointed for thee, when I bring back the captivity of my people.

title: Hosea 7:1
text: When I would heal Israel, then is the iniquity of Ephraim uncovered, and the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief entereth in, and the troop of robbers ravageth without.

title: Hosea 7:2
text: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now have their own doings beset them about; they are before my face.

title: Hosea 7:3
text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

title: Hosea 7:4
text: They are all adulterers; they are as an oven heated by the baker; he ceaseth to stir [the fire], from the kneading of the dough, until it be leavened.

title: Hosea 7:5
text: On the day of our king the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine; he stretched out his hand with scoffers.

title: Hosea 7:6
text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.

title: Hosea 7:7
text: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

title: Hosea 7:8
text: Ephraim, he mixeth himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

title: Hosea 7:9
text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth [it] not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, and he knoweth [it] not.

title: Hosea 7:10
text: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: yet they have not returned unto Jehovah their God, nor sought him, for all this.

title: Hosea 7:11
text: And Ephraim is like a silly dove, without understanding: they call unto Egypt, they go to Assyria.

title: Hosea 7:12
text: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the birds of the heavens; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.

title: Hosea 7:13
text: Woe unto them! for they have wandered from me; destruction unto them! for they have trespassed against me: though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

title: Hosea 7:14
text: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, but they howl upon their beds: they assemble themselves for grain and new wine; they rebel against me.

title: Hosea 7:15
text: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet do they devise mischief against me.

title: Hosea 7:16
text: They return, but not to [him that is] on high; they are like a deceitful bow; their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

title: Hosea 8:1
text: [Set] the trumpet to thy mouth. As an eagle [he cometh] against the house of Jehovah, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

title: Hosea 8:2
text: They shall cry unto me, My God, we Israel know thee.

title: Hosea 8:3
text: Israel hath cast off that which is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

title: Hosea 8:4
text: They have set up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

title: Hosea 8:5
text: He hath cast off thy calf, O Samaria; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

title: Hosea 8:6
text: For from Israel is even this; the workman made it, and it is no God; yea, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

title: Hosea 8:7
text: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: he hath no standing grain; the blade shall yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.

title: Hosea 8:8
text: Israel is swallowed up: now are they among the nations as a vessel wherein none delighteth.

title: Hosea 8:9
text: For they are gone up to Assyria, [like] a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

title: Hosea 8:10
text: Yea, though they hire among the nations, now will I gather them; and they begin to be diminished by reason of the burden of the king of princes.

title: Hosea 8:11
text: Because Ephraim hath multiplied altars for sinning, altars have been unto him for sinning.

title: Hosea 8:12
text: I wrote for him the ten thousand things of my law; but they are counted as a strange thing.

title: Hosea 8:13
text: As for the sacrifices of mine offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; but Jehovah accepteth them not: now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins; they shall return to Egypt.

title: Hosea 8:14
text: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and builded palaces; and Judah hath multiplied fortified cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the castles thereof.

title: Hosea 9:1
text: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, like the peoples; for thou hast played the harlot, [departing] from thy God; thou hast loved hire upon every grain-floor.

title: Hosea 9:2
text: The threshing-floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail her.

title: Hosea 9:3
text: They shall not dwell in Jehovah's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean food in Assyria.

title: Hosea 9:4
text: They shall not pour out wine-offerings to Jehovah, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted; for their bread shall be for their appetite; it shall not come into the house of Jehovah.

title: Hosea 9:5
text: What will ye do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Jehovah?

title: Hosea 9:6
text: For, lo, they are gone away from destruction; [yet] Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them; their pleasant things of silver, nettles shall possess them; thorns shall be in their tents.

title: Hosea 9:7
text: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompense are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the man that hath the spirit is mad, for the abundance of thine iniquity, and because the enmity is great.

title: Hosea 9:8
text: Ephraim [was] a watchman with my God: as for the prophet, a fowler's snare is in all his ways, [and] enmity in the house of his God.

title: Hosea 9:9
text: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

title: Hosea 9:10
text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the first-ripe in the fig-tree at its first season: but they came to Baal-peor, and consecrated themselves unto the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.

title: Hosea 9:11
text: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird: there shall be no birth, and none with child, and no conception.

title: Hosea 9:12
text: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, so that not a man shall be left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

title: Hosea 9:13
text: Ephraim, like as I have seen Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring out his children to the slayer.

title: Hosea 9:14
text: Give them, O Jehovah-what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

title: Hosea 9:15
text: All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them: because of the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house; I will love them no more; all their princes are revolters.

title: Hosea 9:16
text: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved fruit of their womb.

title: Hosea 9:17
text: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

title: Hosea 10:1
text: Israel is a luxuriant vine, that putteth forth his fruit: according to the abundance of his fruit he hath multiplied his altars; according to the goodness of their land they have made goodly pillars.

title: Hosea 10:2
text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found guilty: he will smite their altars, he will destroy their pillars.

title: Hosea 10:3
text: Surely now shall they say, We have no king; for we fear not Jehovah; and the king, what can he do for us?

title: Hosea 10:4
text: They speak [vain] words, swearing falsely in making covenants: therefore judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

title: Hosea 10:5
text: The inhabitants of Samaria shall be in terror for the calves of Beth-aven; for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced over it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

title: Hosea 10:6
text: It also shall be carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

title: Hosea 10:7
text: [As for] Samaria, her king is cut off, as foam upon the water.

title: Hosea 10:8
text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

title: Hosea 10:9
text: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood; the battle against the children of iniquity doth not overtake them in Gibeah.

title: Hosea 10:10
text: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the peoples shall be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.

title: Hosea 10:11
text: And Ephraim is a heifer that is taught, that loveth to tread out [the grain]; but I have passed over upon her fair neck: I will set a rider on Ephraim; Judah shall plow, Jacob shall break his clods.

title: Hosea 10:12
text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness; break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

title: Hosea 10:13
text: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

title: Hosea 10:14
text: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

title: Hosea 10:15
text: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: at daybreak shall the king of Israel be utterly cut off.

title: Hosea 11:1
text: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

title: Hosea 11:2
text: The more [the prophets] called them, the more they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

title: Hosea 11:3
text: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk; I took them on my arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

title: Hosea 11:4
text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; and I was to them as they that lift up the yoke on their jaws; and I laid food before them.

title: Hosea 11:5
text: They shall not return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian shall be their king, because they refused to return [to me].

title: Hosea 11:6
text: And the sword shall fall upon their cities, and shall consume their bars, and devour [them], because of their own counsels.

title: Hosea 11:7
text: And my people are bent on backsliding from me: though they call them to [him that is] on high, none at all will exalt [him].

title: Hosea 11:8
text: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? [how] shall I cast thee off, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? [how] shall I set thee as Zeboiim? my heart is turned within me, my compassions are kindled together.

title: Hosea 11:9
text: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee; and I will not come in wrath.

title: Hosea 11:10
text: They shall walk after Jehovah, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children shall come trembling from the west.

title: Hosea 11:11
text: They shall come trembling as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will make them to dwell in their houses, saith Jehovah.

title: Hosea 11:12
text: Ephraim compasseth me about with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the Holy One.

title: Hosea 12:1
text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he continually multiplieth lies and desolation; and they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

title: Hosea 12:2
text: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

title: Hosea 12:3
text: In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he had power with God:

title: Hosea 12:4
text: yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him at Beth-el, and there he spake with us,

title: Hosea 12:5
text: even Jehovah, the God of hosts; Jehovah is his memorial [name].

title: Hosea 12:6
text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep kindness and justice, and wait for thy God continually.

title: Hosea 12:7
text: [He is] a trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

title: Hosea 12:8
text: And Ephraim said, Surely I am become rich, I have found me wealth: in all my labors they shall find in me no iniquity that were sin.

title: Hosea 12:9
text: But I am Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt; I will yet again make thee to dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

title: Hosea 12:10
text: I have also spoken unto the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets have I used similitudes.

title: Hosea 12:11
text: Is Gilead iniquity? they are altogether false; in Gilgal they sacrifice bullocks; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the field.

title: Hosea 12:12
text: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept [sheep].

title: Hosea 12:13
text: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

title: Hosea 12:14
text: Ephraim hath provoked to anger most bitterly: therefore shall his blood be left upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

title: Hosea 13:1
text: When Ephraim spake, there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

title: Hosea 13:2
text: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

title: Hosea 13:3
text: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the dew that passeth early away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing-floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

title: Hosea 13:4
text: Yet I am Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt; and thou shalt know no god but me, and besides me there is no saviour.

title: Hosea 13:5
text: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

title: Hosea 13:6
text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted: therefore have they forgotten me.

title: Hosea 13:7
text: Therefore am I unto them as a lion; as a leopard will I watch by the way;

title: Hosea 13:8
text: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart; and there will I devour them like a lioness; the wild beast shall tear them.

title: Hosea 13:9
text: It is thy destruction, O Israel, that [thou art] against me, against thy help.

title: Hosea 13:10
text: Where now is thy king, that he may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges, of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?

title: Hosea 13:11
text: I have given thee a king in mine anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

title: Hosea 13:12
text: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is laid up in store.

title: Hosea 13:13
text: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for it is time he should not tarry in the place of the breaking forth of children.

title: Hosea 13:14
text: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from death: O death, where are thy plagues? O Sheol, where is thy destruction? repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

title: Hosea 13:15
text: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the breath of Jehovah coming up from the wilderness; and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall make spoil of the treasure of all goodly vessels.

title: Hosea 13:16
text: Samaria shall bear her guilt; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword; their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

title: Hosea 14:1
text: O Israel, return unto Jehovah thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

title: Hosea 14:2
text: Take with you words, and return unto Jehovah: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and accept that which is good: so will we render [as] bullocks [the offering of] our lips.

title: Hosea 14:3
text: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, [Ye are] our gods; for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

title: Hosea 14:4
text: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; for mine anger is turned away from him.

title: Hosea 14:5
text: I will be as the dew unto Israel; he shall blossom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:6
text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:7
text: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive [as] the grain, and blossom as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:8
text: Ephraim [shall say], What have I to do any more with idols? I have answered, and will regard him: I am like a green fir-tree; from me is thy fruit found.

title: Hosea 14:9
text: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? prudent, that he may know them? for the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but transgressors shall fall therein.

title: Joel 1:1
text: The word of Jehovah that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

title: Joel 1:2
text: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

title: Joel 1:3
text: Tell ye your children of it, and [let] your children [tell] their children, and their children another generation.

title: Joel 1:4
text: That which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the canker-worm eaten; and that which the canker-worm hath left hath the caterpillar eaten.

title: Joel 1:5
text: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and wail, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

title: Joel 1:6
text: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number; his teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the jaw-teeth of a lioness.

title: Joel 1:7
text: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig-tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

title: Joel 1:8
text: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

title: Joel 1:9
text: The meal-offering and the drink-offering are cut off from the house of Jehovah; the priests, Jehovah's ministers, mourn.

title: Joel 1:10
text: The field is laid waste, the land mourneth; for the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

title: Joel 1:11
text: Be confounded, O ye husbandmen, wail, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field is perished.

title: Joel 1:12
text: The vine is withered, and the fig-tree languisheth; the pomegranate-tree, the palm-tree also, and the apple-tree, even all the trees of the field are withered: for joy is withered away from the sons of men.

title: Joel 1:13
text: Gird yourselves [with sackcloth], and lament, ye priests; wail, ye ministers of the altar; come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meal-offering and the drink-offering are withholden from the house of your God.

title: Joel 1:14
text: Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the old men [and] all the inhabitants of the land unto the house of Jehovah your God, and cry unto Jehovah.

title: Joel 1:15
text: Alas for the day! for the day of Jehovah is at hand, and as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

title: Joel 1:16
text: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, [yea], joy and gladness from the house of our God?

title: Joel 1:17
text: The seeds rot under their clods; the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the grain is withered.

title: Joel 1:18
text: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

title: Joel 1:19
text: O Jehovah, to thee do I cry; for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

title: Joel 1:20
text: Yea, the beasts of the field pant unto thee; for the water brooks are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

title: Joel 2:1
text: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain; let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of Jehovah cometh, for it is nigh at hand;

title: Joel 2:2
text: a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness, as the dawn spread upon the mountains; a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.

title: Joel 2:3
text: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and none hath escaped them.

title: Joel 2:4
text: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so do they run.

title: Joel 2:5
text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains do they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

title: Joel 2:6
text: At their presence the peoples are in anguish; all faces are waxed pale.

title: Joel 2:7
text: They run like mighty men; they climb the wall like men of war; and they march every one on his ways, and they break not their ranks.

title: Joel 2:8
text: Neither doth one thrust another; they march every one in his path; and they burst through the weapons, and break not off [their course].

title: Joel 2:9
text: They leap upon the city; they run upon the wall; they climb up into the houses; they enter in at the windows like a thief.

title: Joel 2:10
text: The earth quaketh before them; the heavens tremble; the sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

title: Joel 2:11
text: And Jehovah uttereth his voice before his army; for his camp is very great; for he is strong that executeth his word; for the day of Jehovah is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

title: Joel 2:12
text: Yet even now, saith Jehovah, turn ye unto me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

title: Joel 2:13
text: and rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Jehovah your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

title: Joel 2:14
text: Who knoweth whether he will not turn and repent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal-offering and a drink-offering unto Jehovah your God?

title: Joel 2:15
text: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly;

title: Joel 2:16
text: gather the people, sanctify the assembly, assemble the old men, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts; let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

title: Joel 2:17
text: Let the priests, the ministers of Jehovah, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Jehovah, and give not thy heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the peoples, Where is their God?

title: Joel 2:18
text: Then was Jehovah jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.

title: Joel 2:19
text: And Jehovah answered and said unto his people, Behold, I will send you grain, and new wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations;

title: Joel 2:20
text: but I will remove far off from you the northern [army], and will drive it into a land barren and desolate, its forepart into the eastern sea, and its hinder part into the western sea; and its stench shall come up, and its ill savor shall come up, because it hath done great things.

title: Joel 2:21
text: Fear not, O land, be glad and rejoice; for Jehovah hath done great things.

title: Joel 2:22
text: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth its fruit, the fig-tree and the vine do yield their strength.

title: Joel 2:23
text: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in Jehovah your God; for he giveth you the former rain in just measure, and he causeth to come down for you the rain, the former rain and the latter rain, in the first [month].

title: Joel 2:24
text: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil.

title: Joel 2:25
text: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the canker-worm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer-worm, my great army which I sent among you.

title: Joel 2:26
text: And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and shall praise the name of Jehovah your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you; and my people shall never be put to shame.

title: Joel 2:27
text: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am Jehovah your God, and there is none else; and my people shall never be put to shame.

title: Joel 2:28
text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

title: Joel 2:29
text: and also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my Spirit.

title: Joel 2:30
text: And I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth: blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

title: Joel 2:31
text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Jehovah cometh.

title: Joel 2:32
text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of Jehovah shall be delivered; for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those that escape, as Jehovah hath said, and among the remnant those whom Jehovah doth call.

title: Joel 3:1
text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

title: Joel 3:2
text: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment upon them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations: and they have parted my land,

title: Joel 3:3
text: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.

title: Joel 3:4
text: Yea, and what are ye to me, O Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? will ye render me a recompense? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompense upon your own head.

title: Joel 3:5
text: Forasmuch as ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly precious things,

title: Joel 3:6
text: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem unto the sons of the Grecians, that ye may remove them far from their border;

title: Joel 3:7
text: behold, I will stir them up out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompense upon your own head;

title: Joel 3:8
text: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the men of Sheba, to a nation far off: for Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: Joel 3:9
text: Proclaim ye this among the nations; prepare war; stir up the mighty men; let all the men of war draw near, let them come up.

title: Joel 3:10
text: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning-hooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

title: Joel 3:11
text: Haste ye, and come, all ye nations round about, and gather yourselves together: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Jehovah.

title: Joel 3:12
text: Let the nations bestir themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there will I sit to judge all the nations round about.

title: Joel 3:13
text: Put ye in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe: come, tread ye; for the winepress is full, the vats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

title: Joel 3:14
text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! for the day of Jehovah is near in the valley of decision.

title: Joel 3:15
text: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

title: Joel 3:16
text: And Jehovah will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but Jehovah will be a refuge unto his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.

title: Joel 3:17
text: So shall ye know that I am Jehovah your God, dwelling in Zion my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

title: Joel 3:18
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the brooks of Judah shall flow with waters; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of Jehovah, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

title: Joel 3:19
text: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

title: Joel 3:20
text: But Judah shall abide for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

title: Joel 3:21
text: And I will cleanse their blood, that I have not cleansed: for Jehovah dwelleth in Zion.

title: Amos 1:1
text: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

title: Amos 1:2
text: And he said, Jehovah will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

title: Amos 1:3
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Damascus, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

title: Amos 1:4
text: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

title: Amos 1:5
text: And I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 1:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Gaza, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole people, to deliver them up to Edom:

title: Amos 1:7
text: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

title: Amos 1:8
text: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 1:9
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Tyre, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole people to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

title: Amos 1:10
text: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

title: Amos 1:11
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Edom, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

title: Amos 1:12
text: but I will send a fire upon Teman, and it shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

title: Amos 1:13
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.

title: Amos 1:14
text: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind;

title: Amos 1:15
text: and their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 2:1
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

title: Amos 2:2
text: but I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

title: Amos 2:3
text: and I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 2:4
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have rejected the law of Jehovah, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have caused them to err, after which their fathers did walk:

title: Amos 2:5
text: but I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

title: Amos 2:6
text: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, yea, for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes-

title: Amos 2:7
text: they that pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father go unto the [same] maiden, to profane my holy name:

title: Amos 2:8
text: and they lay themselves down beside every altar upon clothes taken in pledge; and in the house of their God they drink the wine of such as have been fined.

title: Amos 2:9
text: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

title: Amos 2:10
text: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

title: Amos 2:11
text: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazirites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 2:12
text: But ye gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

title: Amos 2:13
text: Behold, I will press [you] in your place, as a cart presseth that is full of sheaves.

title: Amos 2:14
text: And flight shall perish from the swift; and the strong shall not strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;

title: Amos 2:15
text: neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver [himself]; neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself;

title: Amos 2:16
text: and he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 3:1
text: Hear this word that Jehovah hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Amos 3:2
text: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities.

title: Amos 3:3
text: Shall two walk together, except they have agreed?

title: Amos 3:4
text: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

title: Amos 3:5
text: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is [set] for him? shall a snare spring up from the ground, and have taken nothing at all?

title: Amos 3:6
text: Shall the trumpet be blown in a city, and the people not be afraid? shall evil befall a city, and Jehovah hath not done it?

title: Amos 3:7
text: Surely the Lord Jehovah will do nothing, except he reveal his secret unto his servants the prophets.

title: Amos 3:8
text: The lion hath roared; who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken; who can but prophesy?

title: Amos 3:9
text: Publish ye in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold what great tumults are therein, and what oppressions in the midst thereof.

title: Amos 3:10
text: For they know not to do right, saith Jehovah, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

title: Amos 3:11
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An adversary [there shall be], even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be plundered.

title: Amos 3:12
text: Thus saith Jehovah: As the shepherd rescueth out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued that sit in Samaria in the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.

title: Amos 3:13
text: Hear ye, and testify against the house of Jacob, saith the Lord Jehovah, the God of hosts.

title: Amos 3:14
text: For in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also visit the altars of Beth-el; and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

title: Amos 3:15
text: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:1
text: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, that oppress the poor, that crush the needy, that say unto their lords, Bring, and let us drink.

title: Amos 4:2
text: The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that they shall take you away with hooks, and your residue with fish-hooks.

title: Amos 4:3
text: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every one straight before her; and ye shall cast [yourselves] into Harmon, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:4
text: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; to Gilgal, [and] multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, [and] your tithes every three days;

title: Amos 4:5
text: and offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim freewill-offerings and publish them: for this pleaseth you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:6
text: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places; yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:7
text: And I also have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

title: Amos 4:8
text: So two or three cities wandered unto one city to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:9
text: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: the multitude of your gardens and your vineyards and your fig-trees and your olive-trees hath the palmer-worm devoured: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:10
text: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have carried away your horses; and I have made the stench of your camp to come up even into your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:11
text: I have overthrown [cities] among you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a brand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:12
text: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel; [and] because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

title: Amos 4:13
text: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought; that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the Earth-jehovah, the God of hosts, is his name.

title: Amos 5:1
text: Hear ye this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.

title: Amos 5:2
text: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is cast down upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

title: Amos 5:3
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, to the house of Israel.

title: Amos 5:4
text: For thus saith Jehovah unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live;

title: Amos 5:5
text: but seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.

title: Amos 5:6
text: Seek Jehovah, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.

title: Amos 5:7
text: Ye who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth,

title: Amos 5:8
text: [seek him] that maketh the Pleiades and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night; that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth (Jehovah is his name);

title: Amos 5:9
text: that bringeth sudden destruction upon the strong, so that destruction cometh upon the fortress.

title: Amos 5:10
text: They hate him that reproveth in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

title: Amos 5:11
text: Forasmuch therefore as ye trample upon the poor, and take exactions from him of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink the wine thereof.

title: Amos 5:12
text: For I know how manifold are your transgressions, and how mighty are your sins-ye that afflict the just, that take a bribe, and that turn aside the needy in the gate [from their right].

title: Amos 5:13
text: Therefore he that is prudent shall keep silence in such a time; for it is an evil time.

title: Amos 5:14
text: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; and so Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be with you, as ye say.

title: Amos 5:15
text: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish justice in the gate: it may be that Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

title: Amos 5:16
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, the Lord: Wailing shall be in all the broad ways; and they shall say in all the streets, Alas! Alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful in lamentation to wailing.

title: Amos 5:17
text: And in all vineyards shall be wailing; for I will pass through the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 5:18
text: Woe unto you that desire the day of Jehovah! Wherefore would ye have the day of Jehovah? It is darkness, and not light.

title: Amos 5:19
text: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

title: Amos 5:20
text: Shall not the day of Jehovah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

title: Amos 5:21
text: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I will take no delight in your solemn assemblies.

title: Amos 5:22
text: Yea, though ye offer me your burnt-offerings and meal-offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace-offerings of your fat beasts.

title: Amos 5:23
text: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

title: Amos 5:24
text: But let justice roll down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

title: Amos 5:25
text: Did ye bring unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

title: Amos 5:26
text: Yea, ye have borne the tabernacle of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

title: Amos 5:27
text: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith Jehovah, whose name is the God of hosts.

title: Amos 6:1
text: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and to them that are secure in the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!

title: Amos 6:2
text: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?

title: Amos 6:3
text: -ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

title: Amos 6:4
text: that lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

title: Amos 6:5
text: that sing idle songs to the sound of the viol; that invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;

title: Amos 6:6
text: that drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

title: Amos 6:7
text: Therefore shall they now go captive with the first that go captive; and the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.

title: Amos 6:8
text: The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by himself, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts: I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces; therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

title: Amos 6:9
text: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

title: Amos 6:10
text: And when a man's uncle shall take him up, even he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is in the innermost parts of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No; then shall he say, Hold thy peace; for we may not make mention of the name of Jehovah.

title: Amos 6:11
text: For, behold, Jehovah commandeth, and the great house shall be smitten with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

title: Amos 6:12
text: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow [there] with oxen? that ye have turned justice into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood;

title: Amos 6:13
text: ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, that say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

title: Amos 6:14
text: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entrance of Hamath unto the brook of the Arabah.

title: Amos 7:1
text: Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: and, behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.

title: Amos 7:2
text: And it came to pass that, when they made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord Jehovah, forgive, I beseech thee: how shall Jacob stand? for he is small.

title: Amos 7:3
text: Jehovah repented concerning this: It shall not be, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 7:4
text: Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: and, behold, the Lord Jehovah called to content by fire; and it devoured the great deep, and would have eaten up the land.

title: Amos 7:5
text: Then said I, O Lord Jehovah, cease, I beseech thee: how shall Jacob stand? for he is small.

title: Amos 7:6
text: Jehovah repented concerning this: this also shall not be, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 7:7
text: Thus he showed me: and, behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb-line, with a plumb-line in his hand.

title: Amos 7:8
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumb-line. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumb-line in the midst of my people Israel; I will not again pass by them any more;

title: Amos 7:9
text: and the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

title: Amos 7:10
text: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

title: Amos 7:11
text: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.

title: Amos 7:12
text: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thou away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

title: Amos 7:13
text: but prophesy not again any more at Beth-el; for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is a royal house.

title: Amos 7:14
text: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was a herdsman, and a dresser of sycomore-trees:

title: Amos 7:15
text: and Jehovah took me from following the flock, and Jehovah said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

title: Amos 7:16
text: Now therefore hear thou the word of Jehovah: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not [thy word] against the house of Isaac;

title: Amos 7:17
text: therefore thus saith Jehovah: Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou thyself shalt die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.

title: Amos 8:1
text: Thus the Lord Jehovah showed me: and, behold, a basket of summer fruit.

title: Amos 8:2
text: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said Jehovah unto me, The end is come upon my people Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.

title: Amos 8:3
text: And the songs of the temple shall be wailings in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah: the dead bodies shall be many: in every place shall they cast them forth with silence.

title: Amos 8:4
text: Hear this, O ye that would swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,

title: Amos 8:5
text: saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;

title: Amos 8:6
text: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes, and sell the refuse of the wheat?

title: Amos 8:7
text: Jehovah hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

title: Amos 8:8
text: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? yea, it shall rise up wholly like the River; and it shall be troubled and sink again, like the River of Egypt.

title: Amos 8:9
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.

title: Amos 8:10
text: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning for an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.

title: Amos 8:11
text: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord Jehovah, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Jehovah.

title: Amos 8:12
text: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, and shall not find it.

title: Amos 8:13
text: In that day shall the fair virgins and the young men faint for thirst.

title: Amos 8:14
text: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, As thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, As the way of Beer-sheba liveth; they shall fall, and never rise up again.

title: Amos 9:1
text: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar: and he said, Smite the capitals, that the thresholds may shake; and break them in pieces on the head of all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: there shall not one of them flee away, and there shall not one of them escape.

title: Amos 9:2
text: Though they dig into Sheol, thence shall my hand take them; and though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down.

title: Amos 9:3
text: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and it shall bite them.

title: Amos 9:4
text: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

title: Amos 9:5
text: For the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, [is] he that toucheth the land and it melteth, and all that dwell therein shall mourn; and it shall rise up wholly like the River, and shall sink again, like the River of Egypt;

title: Amos 9:6
text: [it is] he that buildeth his chambers in the heavens, and hath founded his vault upon the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth; Jehovah is his name.

title: Amos 9:7
text: Are ye not as the children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith Jehovah. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

title: Amos 9:8
text: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; save that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith Jehovah.

title: Amos 9:9
text: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations, like as [grain] is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least kernel fall upon the earth.

title: Amos 9:10
text: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, who say, The evil shall not overtake nor meet us.

title: Amos 9:11
text: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old;

title: Amos 9:12
text: that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and all the nations that are called by my name, saith Jehovah that doeth this.

title: Amos 9:13
text: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

title: Amos 9:14
text: And I will bring back the captivity of my people Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

title: Amos 9:15
text: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them, saith Jehovah thy God.

title: Obadiah 1:1
text: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning Edom: We have heard tidings from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

title: Obadiah 1:2
text: Behold, I have made thee small among the nations: thou art greatly despised.

title: Obadiah 1:3
text: The pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

title: Obadiah 1:4
text: Though thou mount on high as the eagle, and though thy nest be set among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.

title: Obadiah 1:5
text: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night (how art thou cut off!), would they not steal [only] till they had enough? if grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes?

title: Obadiah 1:6
text: How are [the things of] Esau searched! how are his hidden treasures sought out!

title: Obadiah 1:7
text: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee on thy way, even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; [they that eat] thy bread lay a snare under thee: there is no understanding in him.

title: Obadiah 1:8
text: Shall I not in that day, saith Jehovah, destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

title: Obadiah 1:9
text: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter.

title: Obadiah 1:10
text: For the violence done to thy brother Jacob, shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

title: Obadiah 1:11
text: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

title: Obadiah 1:12
text: But look not thou on the day of thy brother in the day of his disaster, and rejoice not over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither speak proudly in the day of distress.

title: Obadiah 1:13
text: Enter not into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, look not thou on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither lay ye [hands] on their substance in the day of their calamity.

title: Obadiah 1:14
text: And stand thou not in the crossway, to cut off those of his that escape; and deliver not up those of his that remain in the day of distress.

title: Obadiah 1:15
text: For the day of Jehovah is near upon all the nations: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; thy dealing shall return upon thine own head.

title: Obadiah 1:16
text: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the nations drink continually; yea, they shall drink, and swallow down, and shall be as though they had not been.

title: Obadiah 1:17
text: But in mount Zion there shall be those that escape, and it shall be holy; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

title: Obadiah 1:18
text: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall burn among them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining to the house of Esau; for Jehovah hath spoken it.

title: Obadiah 1:19
text: And they of the South shall possess the mount of Esau, and they of the lowland the Philistines; and they shall possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria; and Benjamin [shall possess] Gilead.

title: Obadiah 1:20
text: And the captives of this host of the children of Israel, that are [among] the Canaanites, [shall possess] even unto Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, that are in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the South.

title: Obadiah 1:21
text: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah's.

title: Jonah 1:1
text: Now the word of Jehovah came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

title: Jonah 1:2
text: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

title: Jonah 1:3
text: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of Jehovah; and he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of Jehovah.

title: Jonah 1:4
text: But Jehovah sent out a great wind upon the sea, and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

title: Jonah 1:5
text: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god; and they cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it unto them. But Jonah was gone down into the innermost parts of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

title: Jonah 1:6
text: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

title: Jonah 1:7
text: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

title: Jonah 1:8
text: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; what is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?

title: Jonah 1:9
text: And he said unto them, I am a Hebrew; and I fear Jehovah, the God of heaven, who hath made the sea and the dry land.

title: Jonah 1:10
text: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, What is this that thou hast done? For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Jehovah, because he had told them.

title: Jonah 1:11
text: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea grew more and more tempestuous.

title: Jonah 1:12
text: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

title: Jonah 1:13
text: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not: for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them.

title: Jonah 1:14
text: Wherefore they cried unto Jehovah, and said, We beseech thee, O Jehovah, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood; for thou, O Jehovah, hast done as it pleased thee.

title: Jonah 1:15
text: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea; and the sea ceased from its raging.

title: Jonah 1:16
text: Then the men feared Jehovah exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice unto Jehovah, and made vows.

title: Jonah 1:17
text: And Jehovah prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah; and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

title: Jonah 2:1
text: Then Jonah prayed unto Jehovah his God out of the fish's belly.

title: Jonah 2:2
text: And he said, I called by reason of mine affliction unto Jehovah, And he answered me; Out of the belly of Sheol cried I, [And] thou heardest my voice.

title: Jonah 2:3
text: For thou didst cast me into the depth, in the heart of the seas, And the flood was round about me; All thy waves and thy billows passed over me.

title: Jonah 2:4
text: And I said, I am cast out from before thine eyes; Yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

title: Jonah 2:5
text: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul; The deep was round about me; The weeds were wrapped about my head.

title: Jonah 2:6
text: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The earth with its bars [closed] upon me for ever: Yet hast thou brought up my life from the pit, O Jehovah my God.

title: Jonah 2:7
text: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Jehovah; And my prayer came in unto thee, into thy holy temple.

title: Jonah 2:8
text: They that regard lying vanities Forsake their own mercy.

title: Jonah 2:9
text: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation is of Jehovah.

title: Jonah 2:10
text: And Jehovah spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

title: Jonah 3:1
text: And the word of Jehovah came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

title: Jonah 3:2
text: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

title: Jonah 3:3
text: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of Jehovah. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city, of three days' journey.

title: Jonah 3:4
text: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

title: Jonah 3:5
text: And the people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

title: Jonah 3:6
text: And the tidings reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

title: Jonah 3:7
text: And he made proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;

title: Jonah 3:8
text: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and beast, and let them cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in his hands.

title: Jonah 3:9
text: Who knoweth whether God will not turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

title: Jonah 3:10
text: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil which he said he would do unto them; and he did it not.

title: Jonah 4:1
text: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

title: Jonah 4:2
text: And he prayed unto Jehovah, and said, I pray thee, O Jehovah, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I hasted to flee unto Tarshish; for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

title: Jonah 4:3
text: Therefore now, O Jehovah, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

title: Jonah 4:4
text: And Jehovah said, Doest thou well to be angry?

title: Jonah 4:5
text: Then Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shade, till he might see what would become of the city.

title: Jonah 4:6
text: And Jehovah God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his evil case. So Jonah was exceeding glad because of the gourd.

title: Jonah 4:7
text: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd, that it withered.

title: Jonah 4:8
text: And it came to pass, when the sun arose, that God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and requested for himself that he might die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

title: Jonah 4:9
text: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

title: Jonah 4:10
text: And Jehovah said, Thou hast had regard for the gourd, for which thou hast not labored, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

title: Jonah 4:11
text: and should not I have regard for Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

title: Micah 1:1
text: The word of Jehovah that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:2
text: Hear, ye peoples, all of you: hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord Jehovah be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

title: Micah 1:3
text: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

title: Micah 1:4
text: And the mountains shall be melted under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, as waters that are poured down a steep place.

title: Micah 1:5
text: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?

title: Micah 1:6
text: Therefore I will make Samaria as a heap of the field, [and] as places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will uncover the foundations thereof.

title: Micah 1:7
text: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her hires shall be burned with fire, and all her idols will I lay desolate; for of the hire of a harlot hath she gathered them, and unto the hire of a harlot shall they return.

title: Micah 1:8
text: For this will I lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals, and a lamentation like the ostriches.

title: Micah 1:9
text: For her wounds are incurable; for it is come even unto Judah; it reacheth unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:10
text: Tell it not in Gath, weep not at all: at Beth-le-aphrah have I rolled myself in the dust.

title: Micah 1:11
text: Pass away, O inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame: the inhabitant of Zaanan is not come forth; the wailing of Beth-ezel shall take from you the stay thereof.

title: Micah 1:12
text: For the inhabitant of Maroth waiteth anxiously for good, because evil is come down from Jehovah unto the gate of Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:13
text: Bind the chariot to the swift steed, O inhabitant of Lachish: she was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

title: Micah 1:14
text: Therefore shalt thou give a parting gift to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a deceitful thing unto the kings of Israel.

title: Micah 1:15
text: I will yet bring unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah, him that shall possess thee: the glory of Israel shall come even unto Adullam.

title: Micah 1:16
text: Make thee bald, and cut off thy hair for the children of thy delight: enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

title: Micah 2:1
text: Woe to them that devise iniquity and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

title: Micah 2:2
text: And they covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

title: Micah 2:3
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks, neither shall ye walk haughtily; for it is an evil time.

title: Micah 2:4
text: In that day shall they take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, [and] say, We are utterly ruined: he changeth the portion of my people: how doth he remove [it] from me! to the rebellious he divideth our fields.

title: Micah 2:5
text: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast the line by lot in the assembly of Jehovah.

title: Micah 2:6
text: Prophesy ye not, [thus] they prophesy. They shall not prophesy to these: reproaches shall not depart.

title: Micah 2:7
text: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, Is the Spirit of Jehovah straitened? are these his doings? Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

title: Micah 2:8
text: But of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye strip the robe from off the garment from them that pass by securely [as men] averse from war.

title: Micah 2:9
text: The women of my people ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their young children ye take away my glory for ever.

title: Micah 2:10
text: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your resting-place; because of uncleanness that destroyeth, even with a grievous destruction.

title: Micah 2:11
text: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood do lie, [saying], I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

title: Micah 2:12
text: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture; they shall make great noise by reason of [the multitude of] men.

title: Micah 2:13
text: The breaker is gone up before them: they have broken forth and passed on to the gate, and are gone out thereat; and their king is passed on before them, and Jehovah at the head of them.

title: Micah 3:1
text: And I said, Hear, I pray you, ye heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: is it not for you to know justice?

title: Micah 3:2
text: ye who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

title: Micah 3:3
text: who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

title: Micah 3:4
text: Then shall they cry unto Jehovah, but he will not answer them; yea, he will hide his face from them at that time, according as they have wrought evil in their doings.

title: Micah 3:5
text: Thus saith Jehovah concerning the prophets that make my people to err; that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and whoso putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him:

title: Micah 3:6
text: Therefore it shall be night unto you, that ye shall have no vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down upon the prophets, and the day shall be black over them.

title: Micah 3:7
text: And the seers shall be put to shame, and the diviners confounded; yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.

title: Micah 3:8
text: But as for me, I am full of power by the Spirit of Jehovah, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

title: Micah 3:9
text: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, that abhor justice, and pervert all equity.

title: Micah 3:10
text: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

title: Micah 3:11
text: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet they lean upon Jehovah, and say, Is not Jehovah in the midst of us? no evil shall come upon us.

title: Micah 3:12
text: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

title: Micah 4:1
text: But in the latter days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of Jehovah's house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and peoples shall flow unto it.

title: Micah 4:2
text: And many nations shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths. For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem;

title: Micah 4:3
text: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

title: Micah 4:4
text: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig-tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of Jehovah of hosts hath spoken it.

title: Micah 4:5
text: For all the peoples walk every one in the name of his god; and we will walk in the name of Jehovah our God for ever and ever.

title: Micah 4:6
text: In that day, saith Jehovah, will I assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

title: Micah 4:7
text: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Jehovah will reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth even for ever.

title: Micah 4:8
text: And thou, O tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, yea, the former dominion shall come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

title: Micah 4:9
text: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no king in thee, is thy counsellor perished, that pangs have taken hold of thee as of a woman in travail?

title: Micah 4:10
text: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and shalt dwell in the field, and shalt come even unto Babylon: there shalt thou be rescued; there will Jehovah redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

title: Micah 4:11
text: And now many nations are assembled against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye see [our desire] upon Zion.

title: Micah 4:12
text: But they know not the thoughts of Jehovah, neither understand they his counsel; for he hath gathered them as the sheaves to the threshing-floor.

title: Micah 4:13
text: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; for I will make thy horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass; and thou shalt beat in pieces many peoples: and I will devote their gain unto Jehovah, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

title: Micah 5:1
text: Now shalt thou gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us; they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

title: Micah 5:2
text: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephrathah, which art little to be among the thousands of Judah, out of thee shall one come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.

title: Micah 5:3
text: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she who travaileth hath brought forth: then the residue of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.

title: Micah 5:4
text: And he shall stand, and shall feed [his flock] in the strength of Jehovah, in the majesty of the name of Jehovah his God: and they shall abide; for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

title: Micah 5:5
text: And this [man] shall be [our] peace. When the Assyrian shall come into our land, and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

title: Micah 5:6
